title: Tomato Pasta
instructions: Cook pasta. Saute garlic and tomato in olive oil. Mix with pasta. Garnish with basil.

title: Vegetable Omelette
instructions: Beat eggs. Chop vegetables. Cook vegetables, pour eggs, cook until set.

title: Chickpea Salad
instructions: Mix all ingredients. Dress with olive oil and lemon. Season to taste.

title: Grilled Cheese Sandwich
instructions: Butter bread, place cheese between slices, grill until golden and cheese melts.

title: Stir-fry Vegetables
instructions: Stir-fry garlic in oil, add vegetables, add soy sauce, cook until tender.

title: Pancakes
instructions: Mix ingredients into batter. Cook small pancakes on a hot pan until golden.
